A closely related case is when the hidden-layer weights are fixed or random and only the output weights are learned, which reduces to a least-squares problem solved via the pseudoinverse (eigendecomposition of X^T X). With nonlinear hidden activations and trainable hidden weights, backpropagation-based SGD is the standard approach.
